status: Applications built and integrated; native cellular and voice bring-up incomplete

calls.backend: ModemManager plugin shipped and selected by the GNOME schema override
calls.activation: Upstream calls-daemon user service wanted by gnome-session.target

spacebar.backend: ModemManagerQt Messaging/Sms API; compatible with the generic AT backend
spacebar.activation: Upstream XDG autostart entry for spacebar-daemon
spacebar.storage: Upstream receiver copies incoming messages into the user's SQLite database, then deletes them from modem storage

callaudiod.activation: Standard session D-Bus service installed by programs.calls

applications.chatty: Pinned 0.8.9 requires libcmatrix/olm even without Purple; no SMS-only build switch exists. Spacebar avoids the insecure olm exception and a downstream Chatty fork.

fixes: Restore Qt Quick by correcting the native ShaderToolsTools CMake directory
Discover native Qt/KDE generators through shared builders while retaining target libraries
Run the upstream QML install checks with native qmllint and retain library-mixing guards
Disable unused optional KDE Python bindings; provide native Gom test Python
cross_packaging.native_qt_closure_references: Pinned target QtBase's cross-qmake wrapper references native qmake; Qt translations are architecture-independent. Neither introduces host libraries into the checked application runtime.

qemu_spacebar_startup.isolation: Temporary home, private session bus, unavailable system bus, image fontconfig and software rendering

native_voice.afe_fix: mtk_afe_pcm_pointer checks the DAI id before indexing memory interfaces; Hostless_Speech id 12 has no memif
native_voice.guard_cases: Valid ids preserve the hardware pointer; negative, first out-of-range, Hostless_Speech and INT_MAX ids avoid array/register access
native_voice.existing_route: Hostless_Speech connects ADDA to PCM2/MD1; PCM2 uses mode B and asynchronous FIFO
native_voice.remaining: Establish the modem speech-control contract and an owner that prepares and holds the duplex hostless PCM route for the call lifetime; then integrate the standard ALSA VoiceCall profile used by callaudiod
native_voice.public_vendor_contract: GPL CCCI maps PCM RX/TX channels 4/5 to ccci_aud with user headers. Its kernel port neither decodes speech messages nor supplies a startup acknowledgement; missing channel handling alone does not establish the modem-watchdog cause.

limitations.native_transport_and_sim: Trial 95 reaches HS2 READY, then the modem watchdog fires before SIM diagnostics. ModemManager's SIM-missing fallback does not establish physical card absence.

esim.status: Native modem/eUICC access and GUI integration incomplete
esim.public_board_contract: Planet Gemini user guide identifies physical SIM as slot 1 and eSIM as slot 2.
esim.architecture: Native CCCI exposes standard Linux WWAN AT ports. A generic GUI AT backend should reuse lpac standard APDU commands and ModemManager port/slot metadata with exclusive inhibition ownership; CCCI framing remains a kernel responsibility.
remaining: Fix native fatal AT port lifetime so disconnects wake userspace through standard WWAN removal; qualify the actual path.
Restore public declarative SIM pad ownership at the native modem owner after checking the board mode and pin configuration contract.
Establish stable modem operation and public slot-2/eUICC APDU routing; AT commands do not themselves establish target-slot selection.
Fix lpac unbounded/HUP-only wait handling and establish long eUICC operation response behavior before enabling provisioning.
Add generic AT support to lpa-gtk with standard discovery, exclusive port ownership, cancellation and actionable errors; no automatic slot/profile mutation during discovery.
esim.board_observation: A bounded accepted-113 read exited 1 before pad snapshots; identity, taint and host-idle guards passed, locks released. It establishes neither pad state nor SIM absence; no repeated probe.
